test_title: PYST 19: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
The actual and targeted production (in thousands) of shoes of a company during the last five years are given in the following bar graph. Study the bar graph carefully and answer the question that follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4eaf11349f8a22251bf9fafc0d453df0526371816d1175439c1bdb7b5a767ee.png] 

The total actual production in 2020 and 2021 is what per cent of the total targeted production in 2021 and 2022? (correct up to two decimal places)
solution:
**Given:**

Actual production in 2020 = 17000

Actual production in 2021 = 19000

Targeted production in 2021 = 20000

Targeted production in 2022 = 31000

**Formula used:**

Total actual production in 2020 and 2021 = Actual production in 2020 + Actual production in 2021

Total targeted production in 2021 and 2022 = Targeted production in 2021 + Targeted production in 2022

Percentage = (Total actual production / Total targeted production) × 100

**Calculations:**

Total actual production in 2020 and 2021 = 17000 + 19000

⇒ Total actual production = 36000

Total targeted production in 2021 and 2022 = 20000 + 31000

⇒ Total targeted production = 51000

Percentage = (36000 / 51000) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 70.59%

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
